observed_browser_rate.measurement: Retained completed browser attempts per elapsed minute; excludes unrecorded interrupted calls and is not account capacity.

attempt_audit.body_hash_validation: Every selected successful receipt hash equals retained original capture bytes.
attempt_audit.limitations: Interrupted native workers may have issued calls without completed receipts; the64-call reserve is a conservative budget allowance, not an exact billed count. Browser retry receipt names are append-only UUIDs.

recovery_history.renewed_route: After explicit renewed user authorization, native website-ban failures were followed by small original-URL browserHtml probes. Successful strict rendered JSON recovered the remaining first pass and complete repeated pass. Earlier source/provider failures remain in the retained attempt audit.

limits: An observed stable source crawl, not a transactionally frozen publisher version or a complete official congressional roster.
Source membership is publisher-defined and may omit members without its scored actions; absence does not imply a zero score.
Only API score, vote_index, presence_score and possible_score are qualified. Individual browser grade display and calculated lifetime scores are not reproduced.
General catalog comments/categories remain unmapped in frozen V1; raw captures stay private.
No historical editions, nonempty adjustment ledgers, score reproduction or changed/hidden display scopes are qualified.
No redistribution rights grant found; public evidence contains metadata and hashes only.
